title: O’Connell
html_source: Daniel O'Connell, 1775-1847, tried to repeal (i.e. reverse or remove a law) the act of union, 1801, merging the parliaments of the UK and Ireland.

anchor.prefix: l voice said. I saw three generations since O'Connell's time. I remember the famine in '46. Do you know that the orange lodges agitated for repeal of the union twenty years before
